title: Employer Purchase Exception
description: Product manufacturer not liable if product purchased by employer for workplace use with adequate warnings

content.general_rule: Product manufacturer liable for failure to provide adequate warnings or instructions
content.exception: Product manufacturer not liable if product purchased by employer for workplace use with adequate warnings
conditions: product was purchased by an employer for use at the workplace
product manufacturer had provided warnings or instructions to such employer
